title: Headlights and adaptive lighting
summary: Feedback on headlights centers on favorable comments about light quality and appearance, one complaint about headlight condensation, and many fragments that only mention lighting features or dimming without a clear evaluation.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the headlights for strong lighting performance, wider spread, and appealing appearance.

negative.summary: Negative feedback is limited to a complaint about condensation appearing in the front headlights after a wash.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention headlights, automatic lighting, upgrades, dimming, mirror glare gaps, and regional selective-dimming availability without a clear positive or negative judgment.

limitations: Most sampled fragments in this topic are undetermined, which limits confidence about the dominant customer view.
The cluster includes loosely related subjects such as headlights, dimming mirrors, lighting upgrades, and regional adaptive-lighting configuration, so it is not fully coherent.
Some fragments are very short or incomplete, preventing reliable interpretation of sentiment or the exact issue being described.
